posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I forgot about the slang thread. Awesome!

Ameena:

Got a few more for you…NPCU - Null-Point Calibration Unit (Ab'Zero Module)IT - Isothermic Transducer (Ab'Zero's other Module)MTC - Micro-Targeting Computer (piece of equipment belonging to the Wraith)MDP - Mobile Defence Platform (Baron Blade's deck)Omni-10 (yet another nickname for Omnitron-X)Jim - Chrono Ranger I'll probably think of some more at some point :).

Yay, more good ones. Thank you!

I'm leaving out the real person names, partially because it'll lead to more confusion ("Wait, do you mean Ronway bit you in the face or the Cursed Acolyte did?") and partly because I can't help but feel that "cameos" deserve their own list. And if I included a few of the common ones here, it'd feel all incomplete not to have everyone listed and the list's long enough already.
